rules.text: I2C 主机总线必须用 i2c_new_master_bus() 创建，传入 i2c_master_bus_config_t 并取回 bus 句柄，禁止使用旧版 i2c_driver_install 一类的写法
i2c_device_config_t.device_address 只填 7 位原始地址（不含读写位），MAX30102 填 0x57，不得填 0xAE/0xAF

cite.quote: I2C device raw address. (The 7/10 bit address without read/write bit).

rules.text: 不要依赖芯片内部上拉跑高速率：enable_internal_pullup 内部上拉不够强，高速频率下必须要有外部上拉电阻

cite.quote: Enable internal pullups. Note: This is not strong enough to pullup buses under high-speed frequency. Recommend proper external pull-up if possible

rules.text: MAX30102 的从机 ID 是 7 位固定值 0b1010111（即 0x57），写地址 0xAE、读地址 0xAF；驱动里用 7 位 0x57

cite.section: Slave ID / Table 17. Slave ID Description
cite.quote: The MAX30102 slave ID consists of seven fixed bits, B7–B1 (set to 0b1010111).

rules.text: 开始新的 SpO2 或心率转换前，先把 FIFO_WR_PTR(0x04)、OVF_COUNTER(0x05)、FIFO_RD_PTR(0x06) 三个寄存器清零，保证 FIFO 为空且状态已知

cite.quote: When starting a new SpO2 or heart rate conversion, it is recommended to first clear the FIFO_WR_PTR, OVF_COUNTER, and FIFO_RD_PTR registers to all zeroes (0x00) to ensure the FIFO is empty and in a known state.

rules.text: 读 FIFO_DATA(0x07) 时 I2C 寄存器地址指针不自增：必须在一个事务里连续读出整样本（IR+Red 共 6 字节），不能靠地址自增换样本

cite.quote: Reading the FIFO_DATA register does not automatically increment the register address. Burst reading this register reads data from the same address over and over.

rules.text: FIFO 深度 32 个样本；两通道激活时每样本 6 字节（每通道 3 字节、左对齐 18 位），一次读满一个样本要读 6 字节

cite.quote: The data FIFO consists of a 32-sample memory bank that can store IR and Red ADC data. Since each sample consists of two channels of data, there are 6 bytes of data for each sample, and therefore 192 total bytes of data can be stored in the FIFO.

rules.text: 禁止越过寄存器 0xFF 继续连续读：读到 0xFF 之后地址指针不会回绕到 0x00，多读出的数据无意义

cite.quote: The other exception is 0xFF. Reading more bytes after the 0xFF register does not advance the address pointer back to 0x00, and the data read is not meaningful.

rules.text: 配置寄存器按手册地址访问：FIFO_CONFIG=0x08、MODE_CONFIG=0x09、SPO2_CONFIG=0x0A、LED1_PA=0x0C、LED2_PA=0x0D、SLOT 控制=0x11/0x12，0x0B/0x0E/0x0F 为保留寄存器不要配置

cite.quote: Mode Configuration SHDN RESET MODE[2:0] 0x09 0x00 R/W SpO2 Configuration 0 (Reserved) SPO2_ADC_RGE [1:0] SPO2_SR[2:0] LED_PW[1:0] 0x0A 0x00 R/W RESERVED 0x0B 0x00 R/W LED Pulse Amplitude LED1_PA[7:0] 0x0C 0x00 R/W LED2_PA[7:0] 0x0D 0x00 R/W
